notes:
Dahu 0.102.2 beta for Windows

- Unnamed objects now display their geometry type and a short, persistent identifier in object lists, overlapping-object selection, group members and command references.
- Object Properties shows an Unnamed placeholder while preserving the actual empty name. Imported names and exported project metadata remain unchanged.
- Explicit object names and group names retain priority. Display identifiers stay consistent when objects are reordered or deleted.

Installer and automatic-update package for Windows. Updater signature included; the executable is not Authenticode-signed.
